verdict.rationale: monday.com's own docs say it can trigger automations to eliminate manual work, run workflows the moment data changes, and ship reusable workflow blocks. That points to a native trigger-and-action capability, but there is no in-depth documentation of a rule builder or its configurable triggers and actions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an automation rule builder (when-X-then-Y recipes), the catalogue of available triggers and actions, any limits or quotas, and independent or hands-on corroboration that engineers can build and run such rules.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can build trigger-and-action automation rules to eliminate repetitive manual steps

citations.quote: Enable 2-way sync between monday products and any platform you work with to trigger automations, eliminate manual work, and keep your business in motion.

Ship new reusable workflow blocks, agent skills, and board column types.
Get complex work done in minutes, build any tool, and automate manual work.
